core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hamidat corresponds to the Arabic form حميدات and is glossed in this record as “Praiseworthy.” The record associates the form with root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamidat corresponds to the Arabic form حميدات (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); حَمِيدَات (Ḥamīdāt)). Its core sense is praiseworthy, commendable, laudable. Hamidat is the Arabic plural form حَمِيدَات (Ḥamīdāt) of حَمِيدَة (Ḥamīda) 'praiseworthy', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). It is used as a personal name in South Asian and West African Muslim communities. The source gloss 'praised one, admirable' is a fair rendering of the underlying singular.

persian.name: حمیدات
persian.long_meaning: Hamidat (حمیدات) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ستوده، پسندیده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: حميدات
